english: Hello / Goodbye (āyubōwan; lit. 'may you live long' — the standard polite greeting, used for both hello and goodbye)
Hello (halō; casual, on the phone or to friends, borrowed from English)
Good morning (suba udǣsanak; formal/written, e.g. on signs or TV)
How are you? (kohomada?; the everyday casual form)
How are you doing? (kohomada innē?; lit. 'how are you living/keeping?')
I'm fine / doing well (hoňdin innawā; standard reply)
And you? / How about you? (oyāṭa kohomada?)
I have to go (maṭa yanna wenawā; polite leave-taking)
